subject: engine-tests
title: Sepulcra's rules live in the engine (lex_live)
note: The Sepulcra rule set run live by the engine with no hosted game (lex_live): the engine steps it on its own tick and presents its entities as world entities under /lex_live/sepulcra (here with the default present rules on the slab model), driven by agents' commands through tools alone. Mid-game at Lex tick 9017; the run won at tick 21852 like lex_simulate, and its journal replays headless to the same hash.
